Asset type: production transparent illustration for Twyne's Sentence bench instrument.
Input image: reference image only. Match the LEFT vignette's precise copperplate engraving, not the center linocut or right 3D style.
Primary request: create a single independent illustration of two pale opaque paper wording slips laid next to one another in front of a small dark metal compositor's composing stick, with a short vermilion editorial pencil resting below. Show complete short rows of etched type-like strokes, a red deletion on the left and a tidy red insertion mark on the right; no literal text. One coherent arrangement, very legible as a 64px thumbnail.
Style: beautifully finished mid-century book engraving, warm-black precise etched contours, controlled hatching, small vermilion correction details. Mostly ivory pale paper and warm-black ink; no noisy shading in the text area. The two slips are the main silhouette, the stick and pencil supporting. Dark objects have a fine pale engraved edge that stays legible on dark UI.
Composition: square canvas, center the compact arrangement, fill 82 percent of width and 78 percent of height, all objects fully in frame, no clipping, around 8 percent transparent padding.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency outside the objects, pale areas inside the paper objects are opaque, no background plane, no cast shadow outside the silhouette, no labels or readable words, no human hand, sparkle, robot, emoji, flowers, or other extra decorative objects. Consistent professional print illustration for a calm writing tool.

direction-study:

Asset type: three-direction art comparison for Twyne, an editorial writing instrument, NOT a finished website or UI mockup.
Primary request: Create ONE wide transparent contact sheet containing THREE well separated small illustrations of the SAME subject in THREE distinct, sophisticated editorial styles. The subject is a sentence-revision bench: two narrow off-white paper wording slips laid next to one another, a short red editorial pencil, and a small dark metal composing stick. The objects must be legible at a thumbnail size. Use meaningful short hatch strokes for writing instead of words.

Center vignette: 'Letterpress cutouts' direction, bold, flat cut-paper and linocut silhouettes, muted indigo-black shapes and a single red editing accent, deliberately tactile broken ink edges, strongest thumbnail legibility.

Constraints: real alpha transparent background, no cast background plane, no labels, no letters, no border around sheet, no sparkle, no emoji, no robot, no human or hand, no flowers or unrelated decor, no large shadows. Rich professional illustration, not thin crude sketch or generic app icons. These assets will live inside a writing tool and must feel calm.
